scripts.build: bun run build:sqlite && bun run build:postgresql
scripts.migration:postgresql:drop: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit drop --config ./configs/postgresql.config.ts
scripts.migration:postgresql:generate: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit generate --config ./configs/postgresql.config.ts
scripts.migration:postgresql:run: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit migrate --config ./configs/postgresql.config.ts && bun run seed  && bun run migration:custom
scripts.migration:sqlite:drop: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit drop --config ./configs/sqlite.config.ts
scripts.migration:sqlite:generate: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit generate --config ./configs/sqlite.config.ts
scripts.push:postgresql: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit push --config ./configs/postgresql.config.ts
scripts.push:sqlite: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit push --config ./configs/sqlite.config.ts
scripts.studio: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit studio --config ./configs/sqlite.config.ts
scripts.studio:postgresql: bun run with-env bun --bun drizzle-kit studio --config ./configs/postgresql.config.ts
